retry.accepted: Receiver retry requested. The state will update after the bind attempt.

remediation.bindConflict: Stop or reconfigure the local process using 127.0.0.1:4318, then retry this receiver.

otlp_bind_failed.message: The OTLP receiver could not bind its fixed loopback port.
otlp_bind_failed.remediation: Stop or reconfigure the local process using 127.0.0.1:4318, then retry this receiver.

otlp_invalid_content_type.message: An OTLP log request used an unsupported content type.
otlp_invalid_content_type.remediation: Configure the local exporter to send OTLP Logs as application/x-protobuf or application/json.

otlp_compressed_body_too_large.message: A compressed OTLP log batch exceeded the accepted size.
otlp_compressed_body_too_large.remediation: Reduce the exporter's log batch size before retrying.

otlp_decompressed_body_too_large.message: An expanded OTLP log batch exceeded the accepted size.
otlp_decompressed_body_too_large.remediation: Reduce the exporter's log batch size before retrying.

otlp_gzip_decode_failed.message: A gzip-compressed OTLP log batch could not be decoded.
otlp_gzip_decode_failed.remediation: Verify that the exporter declares gzip only when the request body is valid gzip data.

otlp_json_decode_failed.message: An OTLP JSON log batch did not match the registered OTLP Logs schema.
otlp_json_decode_failed.remediation: Verify the exporter emits standard OTLP Logs JSON for the selected content type.

otlp_protobuf_decode_failed.message: An OTLP Protobuf log batch did not match the registered OTLP Logs schema.
otlp_protobuf_decode_failed.remediation: Verify the exporter emits standard OTLP Logs Protobuf for the selected content type.

otlp_decode_timed_out.message: An OTLP log batch exceeded the bounded decode time.
otlp_decode_timed_out.remediation: Reduce the exporter's log batch size and send the batch again.

persistence_commit_failed.message: Accepted metadata could not be committed to local monitoring storage.
persistence_commit_failed.remediation: Restart CodexMonitor. If the error continues, verify the current user can write the application data directory.

source_checkpoint_invalid.message: The source checkpoint could not be validated.
source_checkpoint_invalid.remediation: Restart the source integration, then restart CodexMonitor if the error continues.

source_unavailable.message: The registered telemetry source is unavailable.
source_unavailable.remediation: Restart the local source integration, then retry or restart CodexMonitor.

internal_queue_closed.message: The source processing queue has stopped.
internal_queue_closed.remediation: Restart CodexMonitor to recreate the local processing queue.
